items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: Talking about Steve and Freddie? Stephen. Well, Freddie was playing guitar, but Steve and Joe, or Erasmus, which was his right name, owned the club.

ctx.x: in those days. Did you name a trombone? Or did he have one?

Oh, I would have been Julian Lane if I omitted him, yes. When did you first meet Almond Hug? Oh, I don't know. I guess about a hundred years ago. I knew Almond. The first time I really got to know Almond was when I went to work for the Lloyd County Brothers when they had the place out at the lake. The name escapes me for the moment, a very successful club. And Almond was playing piano because of course that was part of his family, they were brother-in-laws, you see. He had married one of the Lloyd County girls.…
What was Mouse Pecoraro's real name? You know the drummer?
